newsitem.title: USA: SC&T appeals delisting of its common stock.
newsitem.headline: SC&T appeals delisting of its common stock.

text.p: SC&T International Inc said Monday it has appealed the proposed delisting of its common stock from the Nasdaq stock market.
As a result, the company said its common stock will not be delisted pending resolution of the appeal.
The company said it believes it meets every "objective standard" for continued listing of its common stock.

The company reported June 24 that Nasdaq contended it failed to show it exercised sufficient due dilligence and entered into capital raising transactions that excessively rewarded investors who bought its securities outside the public marketplace.
SC&T International makes products for the multimedia, interactive and communications segments of the personal computer and video gaming industries.
